items.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: And of course there’s Nedra Wheeler. Have you heard of Nedra?

ctx.x: Oh, Yanni or one of those fellows?
Yes. She’s playing with him now, Yanni. And of course there’s Nedra Wheeler. Have you heard of Nedra?
